frames.narration: A fraud model uses the feature 'days since signup'. The training pipeline computes it in batch, as whole days.
The serving service computes the same feature for a live request, written separately. It rounds up.
For a customer who signed up 50 hours ago, the model was trained on 2 and is shown 3. No error is raised.
In our five examples, two of the values differ, which is 40 percent. The model quietly gets worse, and the average hides which customers are hit.
The monitor logs the features the serving path really used and compares them with what training would compute for the same customer and time.
The fix is one definition of the feature, shared by both paths or served from a feature store, plus continued monitoring.
